title: Props, every state
prompt: Paint one sheet of cut-out puppet parts for a paper-puppet film, using the attached image. Panel A is the exact layout, panel B is our footage for these props (reference: copy the object, not the photo style), panel C is the style. STYLE (panel C): flat cards cut from corrugated cardboard, gouache with confident ink linework, the flutes faintly showing through the paint, a thin raw kraft-brown cut edge round every card, brass split-pin brads; shot flat-on, even light, no shadows, no perspective. Copy the craft from C, not the clothes in it. WHAT (panel B): the props of the poem 'Nevermore', one row each, every state of a prop in its own cell, left to right: the heart: an anatomical heart, deep red, two lobes and a taper, shaking grit off as it beats; one blue point of light in it (throbbing in the sand, dusted, floating, seated in the chest, leading the trail); the left hand: the poet's own left hand, dusty, palm-down: a broad palm slab, four short fingers, a thumb and a wrist stub (palm-down in the grit, being seated, flexing, at his side); the right hand: the mirror of the left, dusty, palm-down (palm-down in the grit, being seated, flexing, at his side); NEVERMORE: the word NEVERMORE, first laid down as ink over the flat sea, then cut as paper out of the dark field (No still in the index fits; designed from the treatment and the world module.) (arriving in ink, arriving cut out of dark); the broken pieces: 03's rim arcs, skin and jingles, lying open in the ash-covered sand (a trail in the sand, the half-buried pile); the ravens: three to five black ravens, wings wide (No still in the index fits; designed from the treatment and the world module.) (circling, flying ahead up the trail); puzzle pieces of faith: handcrafted wooden puzzle pieces with gilded edges that lock, scramble, then scatter as seeds (No still in the index fits; designed from the treatment and the world module.) (handcrafted, scrambled, scattered as mustard seeds); the golden blooms: golden flower heads on tall stems with paper-pale centres (closed, opening, facing him); the expired wildfires: four charred stumps with torn tops, ash around them (cold, ashed); the lanterns on the shore steps: small iron lanterns with warm flames on each landing of the shore steps (lit, flicker). Paint each state as a flat cardboard prop card at the size its cell gives, the same object across its row; a brass brad on the green cross (its pivot); where there is a red cross, that is where a hand grips it. LAYOUT (panel A): paint one card inside each grey ghost, in the same place, size and angle, inside its dashed outline; a brass brad exactly on every green cross; each red cross must fall inside that card's rounded end. NEVER draw a pelvis, hip, shorts or briefs card (the thighs end in a rounded seat that tucks under the hem), a sleeveless vest, lace-up boots, or sunglasses painted onto a head. OUTPUT: only the painted cards on a pure white 2048x1152 sheet laid out as panel A. Leave out panels B and C, the crosses, labels, ruler, dashed lines and ghosts.
